acceptance.item: P6-RT-05-01: Attacks 29 and 45: on /embed/<id> links drawn inside a tool keep the browser's default link colour (#0000EE), 1.99 to 1 on the dark page
acceptance.test: site/tests/e2e/embed.spec.ts > the dark theme on the embed routes > dark theme, /embed/atlas/?g=E8: every link inside the tool is at least 4.5 to 1 against the page (A-6); ... /embed/affine/ after Play on of the pentagon puzzle ...; control ...; dark theme, /embed/garden/: every tab stop of the tool shows the focus ring it shows on /tools/garden/ (A-2)
acceptance.evidence: Severity major (no adjustment). Red at base 9b24eea: atlas and affine 'ratio 1.99' on rgb(0, 0, 238) against rgb(18, 18, 18); garden jumpRow and data-table-node buttons 'auto 1px'. Cause: the link colour and the a/button focus-visible rule lived only in Base.astro's is:global style, which the embed page does not use. The two rules moved unchanged to styles/base.css, which both pages import. Green: embed.spec.ts 101 passed. Commit 7d61e68.

acceptance.item: P6-RT-05-02: Attacks 9, 33, 34 and 39: while a prediction is pending, the 'Show as table' view of T13 (M9 b6, b7) and T9 (M1 b5) overflows at 320 with no tab stop (axe scrollable-region-focusable, serious)
acceptance.test: site/tests/e2e/frozen-table-scroll.spec.ts > /modules/m9-real-forms/ satake b6 (b7; M1 kostant b5; M3 kostant b8) at 320 x 800, prediction pending, "Show as table" open: the table view can be scrolled from the keyboard
acceptance.evidence: Severity major (no adjustment). Red at base: '370 in 288 ... focusable inside 0' on b6 and b7, '306 in 288' on M1 b5, axe serious on 'details[open=""] > .bare'. Cause: the table view scrolled inside a fieldset with no tab stop, so it was reachable only through buttons that are all disabled while frozen (and before hydration). Fix in ToolFrame only: the box is a div with tabindex 0, role group, aria-label 'Table of <title>', the A-2 ring and the hook data-scroll="table-view", outside the fieldset, which still disables the buttons. Green: 12 passed with predict tests. Bite: tabindex removed in a scratch build, 4 frozen tests red with the same messages. M3 b8 was added to the reproducer's cases. Commit e2844c8.

acceptance.item: P6-RT-05-02 (sibling): the table view's box had no tab stop before hydration and without JavaScript (the fieldset is disabled)
acceptance.test: site/tests/e2e/frozen-table-scroll.spec.ts > without JavaScript > /modules/m9-real-forms/ satake b6 at 320 x 800 without JavaScript, "Show as table" open: Tab from the summary reaches the box, which scrolls from the keyboard
acceptance.evidence: Same cause and fix (commit e2844c8). Red on the scratch build without tabindex: 'the box is a tab stop of its own' Expected 0, Received -1. Chromium alone reaches a scroll box with nothing focusable inside, so the test asserts tabIndex; green on the final build.

acceptance.item: P6-RT-05-04: Attacks 1 and 9: a prediction's negative answer is shown and announced with the ASCII hyphen-minus, not read through speak ('minus'); first reached on M9 b6 and b7
acceptance.test: site/tests/e2e/predict-answer-minus.spec.ts > M9 b6: "Show me" by keys announces the negative answer with "minus" and shows it with U+2212 (plus M9 b7 and M0 b4 'Show me', and M0 b4 a wrong answer)
acceptance.evidence: Severity minor (no adjustment); Predict.svelte and interop.ts are files of this cluster. Red at base: 'Expected "The answer is (−1, −1, 0)." Received "The answer is (-1, -1, 0)."'; live region 'Shown. The answer is (-1, -1, 0). ...'. Cause: the result line and the announcement were built from predictionAnswerText's raw join. interop.ts adds predictionAnswerShown (displayValue) and predictionAnswerSpoken (speak, speakList); Predict uses them. Green: 4 tests passed, predict-result.spec.ts 3 passed. Bite: Predict pointed back at predictionAnswerText in a scratch build, all 4 red. Commit e4febcc.

acceptance.item: P6-RT-06-01: Attacks 1 and 10, retest of P5-RT-06-01: the no-JS runs accept a blank T13 panel figure (M9 b3 shadow picture, b7 and b12 restricted board) and a blank T14 board drawing as the default figure
acceptance.test: site/tests/e2e/nojs.spec.ts > retest P5-RT-06-01 on T13: a blank shadow picture or restricted board passes the runs without JavaScript (M9 b3, b7, b12); same cause on T14: a blank drawing passes the runs without JavaScript (atlas/B3/, tools/atlas/); a T13 panel that names its restricted board without drawing it, or a shadow picture with empty points, is rejected without JavaScript (M9 b3, b7); site/tests/e2e/M9.spec.ts > without JavaScript > the panel figures without JavaScript: the shadow picture of b3, the restricted boards of b7 and b12; site/tests/e2e/T14.spec.ts > regressions > without JavaScript every Atlas drawing holds a disc and a label per node (atlas/B3/, tools/atlas/)
acceptance.evidence: Severity minor (no adjustment); a test-strength finding, so the test is the fix. Red at base (reproducer) and again with the base predicate (scratch revert): ['b3 as board', 'b7 as board', 'b12 as board'] and ['atlas (page) as drawing'] on both routes. Cause: the predicate checked a figure's container, not its marks (any child element counted), and never read T13's configured panel. Fix: SVG figures need a mark outside defs, title and desc; every shown board group and named drawing must hold content; T13's shadow-picture needs a drawn data-point, restricted-board a board, and a panel naming its restricted board must draw it. HTML role-img drawings keep the old rule (commit 2dc24dd, so nothing is loosened). Green: 6 passed; full nojs sweep 198 passed. The M9 and T14 additions fail on built pages with the figures removed, where the existing checks still pass. Commits 46c73aa, 2dc24dd.

Changing them to U+2212 would change expected values in site/tests/unit/tools/T01.test.ts ('(1, -1, 1)') and site/tests/e2e/M9.spec.ts ('every prediction has a details fallback', tuple(THETA13)); left for the owner.

Chromium makes a scroll box with nothing focusable inside keyboard-reachable by itself, so a Tab-only Chromium test cannot show a missing tab stop; tests should assert tabIndex or use axe scrollable-region-focusable.

handoff: Files outside the shared-component area: site/src/components/tools/t01/interop.ts (two new pure exports beside predictionAnswerText; that function is unchanged), site/tests/e2e/M9.spec.ts (one new test in its no-JS describe, no content touched) and site/tests/e2e/T14.spec.ts (a regressions block and a header hook name); T13SatakeStudio.svelte and T09 are not edited, since the box is now the tab stop and their table buttons can stay disabled while frozen (the P1-A5 and RT-FIX-P3 records). proposedFix of P6-RT-05-02 asked for role=region; I used role=group, the site's pattern for scroll boxes, to avoid several landmarks with one name on a lesson (axe landmark-unique). The lens rerun should read the box by data-scroll="table-view", not fieldset.bare. The T13-cluster fixer should keep T13's table inside ToolFrame's table snippet, which the box wraps.
